People are amazing

Keep things going cos I am already more fortunate than many others.

Sun May 28 2023

I believe that people are amazing and if there’s ever a chance you can do something different/great/remarkable/unforgettable/meaningful, then do it. There are so many people living regretfully out there but if we can dig ourselves out of it, then we absolutely should.

If people like me are so fortunate as to have the privilege of the possibility to recover, then it is our right as human beings to get back up and to help others who need a new hand for them to start and keep on going.
